You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm64/boot/dts/amlogic/meson-sm1-khadas-vim3l.dts`**
   - The block of code defining the `&sd_emmc_a` node has been moved from a commented section to an active section of the device tree source (DTS) file.
   - The `&sd_emmc_a` node now includes the property `sd-uhs-sdr50`, which is necessary for loading the Wi-Fi firmware on the Khadas VIM3L.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a bug related to the Wi-Fi functionality on the Khadas VIM3L. By moving the `&sd_emmc_a` node definition into an active part of the DTS file, the system can now properly load the Wi-Fi firmware, which was previously failing due to the node being commented out. This change is directly linked to the error messages indicating that the Wi-Fi chip was not being recognized, as the necessary configuration for the SD card interface was not being applied.

Here is the commit message:
arm64: dts: meson: fix broken wifi node for Khadas VIM3L

move &sd_emmc_a ... from /* */ commented area, because cant load wifi fw
without sd-uhs-sdr50 option on VIM3L

[   11.696382] brcmfmac: brcmf_sdio_probe_attach: brcmf_chip_attach failed!
[   11.706240] brcmfmac: brcmf_sdio_probe: brcmf_sdio_probe_attach failed
[   11.715890] brcmfmac: brcmf_ops_sdio_probe: F2 error, probe failed -19...
[   13.718424] brcmfmac: brcmf_chip_recognition: chip backplane type 15 is not supported

Signed-off-by: Artem Lapkin <art@khadas.com>
Fixes: f1bb924e8f5b ("arm64: dts: meson: fix mmc0 tuning error on Khadas VIM3")
Reviewed-by: Neil Armstrong <narmstrong@baylibre.com>
Signed-off-by: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210129085041.1408540-1-art@khadas.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the `&sd_emmc_a` node being commented out in the device tree source (DTS) file, which prevented the system from applying the necessary configuration (`sd-uhs-sdr50`) required for loading the Wi-Fi firmware on the Khadas VIM3L. As a result, the Wi-Fi chip could not be recognized, leading to probe failures and error messages indicating that the CPU core was not detected.

Here is the patch:
 };

-};

 &usb {
 	phys = <&usb2_phy0>, <&usb2_phy1>;
  */
 
+&sd_emmc_a {
+	sd-uhs-sdr50;
+};
--
